verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single first-party marketing claim that Zoho Invoice lets you send tax-compliant invoices. That implies some native tax handling, but nothing shows how sales tax, VAT, or GST are calculated, configured, or kept correct. Missing for 10: documented per-invoice tax calculation, sales tax/VAT/GST rate configuration, tax registration handling, any tax-engine integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, sales tax, VAT, and GST are calculated on every invoice — natively or through a first-class tax integration — with the right registrations and rates
